part_a.title: Yuko Asahina's Operation
part_a.teaser: Four weeks after her discharge, Yuko Asahina returns to Internal Medicine for a fasting targeted ultrasound—where Shiori Fujisaki spots a formed appendiceal fecalith lodged near the base. The next morning in the OR, you and Shiori team up as lead surgeon and first assistant for her awake spinal-anesthesia appendectomy.
part_a.gallery_caption: A joint surgical consult after targeted ultrasound reveals an appendiceal fecalith, spinal sensory-level testing, and a poised open appendectomy.

choices.choice_slv3a_039_a: "Dr. Fujisaki has laid out the pros and cons clearly. Taking care of it electively outside an acute flare is the safest surgical window too."
choices.choice_slv3a_039_b: "Sorry, Ms. Asahina—looks like that 'not for now' from four weeks ago officially expires today."

nodes.slv3a_001: At ten past three in the afternoon, clear sunlight streamed past the window of the Internal Medicine consultation room.
nodes.slv3a_002: Sitting on the round stool across the desk, Yuko Asahina swung her toes lightly as she slipped her phone back into her handbag, grinning at Shiori Fujisaki while Shiori pulled up her test archives on the monitor.
nodes.slv3a_003: "Long time no see, Attending Physician Fujisaki! Just like you lectured me a thousand times before discharge, I skipped breakfast all morning yesterday and got both the follow-up ultrasound and bloodwork done—today's just a formality to pick up my 'Clean Bill of Health' certificate, right?"
nodes.slv3a_004: Clicking open the high-resolution targeted ultrasound images and lab sheet just sent up from Radiology, Shiori answered in an easy, gentle tone.
nodes.slv3a_005: "Whether you pass or not depends on what the results say first. Tell me honestly, Yuko-chan—over these past four weeks of busy campaign planning at work, did the right side of your stomach really not act up once?"
nodes.slv3a_006: Yuko's bright grin faltered for half a second. Her gaze drifted toward the ceiling, and she held up two fingers a tiny pinch apart.
nodes.slv3a_007: "Uh... if we're counting every tiny thing, after working late last Thursday and grabbing midnight snacks—and again the afternoon before yesterday when I drank an iced latte rushing a proposal—it did tug and ache down on the lower right twice. Each time only dragged on for an hour or so and went away once I rested, way milder than the day I was hospitalized!"
nodes.slv3a_008: Shiori did not answer right away.
nodes.slv3a_009: Her right hand stilled on the mouse. Leaning slightly toward the monitor, she scrolled frame by frame through the magnified grayscale ultrasound views of the right iliac fossa, then glanced down to cross-check the freshly printed report and white-blood-cell differential.
nodes.slv3a_010: For a moment, the only sound in the consultation room was the quiet rustle of paper.
nodes.slv3a_011: Little by little, the warm smile Shiori usually wore for her old classmate faded from her lips. Her neat brows drew lightly together, then furrowed deeper and deeper until even her fingertip stopped over the parameter column.
nodes.slv3a_012: Across the desk, Yuko had been twirling a lock of hair by her ear. Seeing that look on her friend's face, her swinging toes came to a halt, and her back straightened inch by inch.
nodes.slv3a_013: "...H-hey, Shiori? Why'd you go quiet all of a sudden? Don't scare me—what does the sheet say? Watching you frown like that is making my heart race..."
nodes.slv3a_014: Shiori let out a quiet breath, laid the printed ultrasound report flat on the desk, turned it so Yuko could see, and raised her eyes to look at her seriously.
nodes.slv3a_015: "Yuko-chan, I'm afraid I can't hand you that clean bill of health this time. Because your bowel was empty and free of gas interference yesterday, the targeted ultrasound captured a crystal-clear view of the spot we couldn't see before."
nodes.slv3a_016: She rested the tip of her fountain pen steadily on a bright echogenic focus casting a sharp acoustic shadow near the center of the grayscale image, her voice calm and unmistakable.
nodes.slv3a_017: "The wall of your appendix shows clear chronic inflammatory thickening, and the lumen is noticeably dilated. Most importantly, wedged inside the lumen near the base of the appendix is a formed appendiceal fecalith. Every bout of right lower abdominal cramping you've had after late nights or big dinners over the past few months—this stone is the culprit."
nodes.slv3a_018: Yuko stared down at that tiny white spot, blinked twice, and her voice jumped half an octave.
nodes.slv3a_019: "A f-fecalith?! Hold on, Shiori... last time I was admitted, after you and Dr. Sakaguchi consulted together, didn't you tell me yourselves that I didn't need surgery?!"
nodes.slv3a_020: "Last time wasn't the same as today. Four weeks ago, your symptoms subsided as soon as you finished IV fluids, and your abdomen was soft on palpation. Bowel gas hid this lodged stone from view, and there was zero sign of perforation or peritonitis—so at that moment, there really wasn't grounds to rush you onto an operating table."
nodes.slv3a_022: Meeting her old classmate's tense gaze, Shiori didn't offer vague reassurance just to make her feel better; her expression remained candid and steady.
nodes.slv3a_023: "Now both the cause and the stone are clearly confirmed, and it has already flared up twice in a single month. Yuko-chan, this time—I believe having surgery to remove it is the better choice."
nodes.slv3a_024: "When you say it that decisively, it makes me even more terrified!!"
nodes.slv3a_025: Clapping both hands over her cheeks, Yuko nearly slid halfway off the round stool, peeking pitifully at Shiori between her fingers.
nodes.slv3a_026: "How did it come to this...?! Here I thought Dr. Sakaguchi's 'not for now' was a get-out-of-jail-free pass, and just four weeks later it's time to face the scalpel for real?!"
nodes.slv3a_027: Watching her spiral, Shiori let out a soft sigh and reached for the internal extension handset on her desk.
nodes.slv3a_028: "Don't scare yourself ahead of time. As for the exact treatment options and how an operation would be arranged, let's ask Dr. Sakaguchi from Surgery to step over so the three of us can talk everything through face-to-face, all right?"
nodes.slv3a_029: Five minutes later, Ryuji Sakaguchi pushed open the door of the Internal Medicine consultation room and stepped inside.
nodes.slv3a_030: Standing beside the desk, Shiori handed him the new targeted ultrasound prints and the four-week symptom log, delivering a concise clinical handoff. After examining the sharply defined echogenic fecalith and thickened appendiceal wall on the scans, Ryuji looked up and gave Yuko a calm, reassuring nod.
nodes.slv3a_031: "Good to see you again, Ms. Asahina. I've gone over the images and lab numbers, and the picture really has changed since four weeks ago—the root cause that was hiding behind bowel gas has finally shown itself."
nodes.slv3a_032: Clutching her handbag tightly against her chest like a last lifeline, Yuko looked up at the two doctors.
nodes.slv3a_033: "Dr. Sakaguchi, Shiori... let me ask one last time, seriously! Since I'm not rolling around in emergency pain right now, is there really zero way to avoid surgery? Like... two more days of anti-inflammatory IV drips like last time to slowly dissolve that stone or something?"
nodes.slv3a_034: Sitting straight behind the desk again, Shiori didn't rush Yuko toward a consent form; instead, she laid out the trade-offs of both paths plainly for her old friend.
nodes.slv3a_035: "Medically speaking, conservative management with antibiotics to quiet the inflammation does exist, and if a patient firmly refuses surgery, no doctor can force the decision on you."
nodes.slv3a_036: At the first half of her sentence, Yuko's eyes had barely lit up before Shiori shook her head gently, every word clear and measured.
nodes.slv3a_037: "However, as your attending physician, I don't recommend taking that road this time. The appendix is a narrow blind tube opening into the bowel at only one end, and an IV drip cannot dissolve a hardened fecalith wedged inside it. As long as that stone stays put, the next business trip, late night, or rich dinner could plug the lumen completely—turning into acute suppuration or even perforation and peritonitis, which means far worse pain, a harder incision, and a much rougher recovery."
nodes.slv3a_038: She paused for half a beat, looking straight into Yuko's eyes.
nodes.slv3a_039: "Scheduling a calm, planned appendectomy right now while the inflammation is localized and free of dense adhesions carries the lowest risk and the fastest recovery—so my recommendation is still surgery."
nodes.slv3a_040: Setting the ultrasound report gently back on the desk, Ryuji nodded and picked up where Shiori left off.
nodes.slv3a_041: "Dr. Fujisaki has laid out the pros and cons thoroughly. From a surgeon's standpoint, it's the exact same conclusion—rather than risking a midnight perforation and an emergency scramble, taking care of it proactively while the tissues are clean keeps the operation short and spares you a great deal of misery afterward."
nodes.slv3a_042: Looking from Shiori's resolute expression to Ryuji's steady calm, Yuko let her shoulders slump bit by bit.
nodes.slv3a_043: "Ugh... last time when the two of you tag-teamed telling me I didn't need surgery, you sounded like angels—how come today when you're tag-teaming to talk me under the knife, you still make total sense..."
nodes.slv3a_044: Looking at Yuko hugging her handbag for dear life, Ryuji offered a dry, gentle quip.
nodes.slv3a_045: "My apologies, Ms. Asahina. It seems the shelf life on that 'not for now' I gave you four weeks ago only lasted until this afternoon."
nodes.slv3a_046: Yuko's mouth twitched, and she slapped her thigh in tragic indignation.
nodes.slv3a_047: "I knew it!! When I went out for drinks after discharge I bragged to everyone that I'd dodged the bullet, and all along that 'for now' was just a suspended sentence!"
nodes.slv3a_048: Shiori couldn't help covering her lips with a quiet laugh before quickly composing herself to soothe her friend:
nodes.slv3a_049: "Precisely because we kept our guard up and brought you back for a follow-up, we caught it today before it could cause real trouble."
nodes.slv3a_050: Glancing open tomorrow's OR schedule, Ryuji outlined the concrete plan for Yuko step by step.
nodes.slv3a_051: "A routine open appendectomy is a very well-established procedure here—it takes roughly an hour from start to finish. We happen to have an open elective morning slot tomorrow. Check into the ward tonight to fast and rest; tomorrow morning we'll use spinal anesthesia—a local block in your lower back—so you'll stay awake during the procedure without feeling any pain below the waist. I'll be handling the operation myself."
nodes.slv3a_052: Yuko drew in a huge breath, squeezed her eyes shut for a three-second internal battle, and finally gritted her teeth and held out her hand:
nodes.slv3a_053: "...Fine, fine! Better a short pain than a long worry—and having Dr. Sakaguchi and Shiori here beats handing myself over to strangers at another hospital any day! Where do I sign? Let me sign before my courage runs out!"
nodes.slv3a_054: As Yuko signed the surgical consent form with heroic flair while still muttering "Oh god, I'm actually going on an operating table tomorrow" under her breath, Shiori's gaze softened. Turning toward Ryuji, she spoke up on her own initiative.
nodes.slv3a_055: "Dr. Sakaguchi, for Yuko-chan's appendectomy tomorrow morning—would you allow me to scrub in as your first assistant?"
nodes.slv3a_056: Having just clicked the pen cap shut, Yuko whipped her head up, eyes wide as saucers.
nodes.slv3a_057: "W-wait a second, Shiori! Aren't you an internist?!"
nodes.slv3a_058: Shiori patted the back of her hand, poised and composed.
nodes.slv3a_059: "Dr. Sakaguchi will be the lead surgeon, of course. Still, I completed formal training in retraction, exposure, and field assistance for routine open procedures during my surgical rotation, so assisting at the table is well within scope—and that way I can stay right beside you too."
nodes.slv3a_060: "Hearing you say so calmly that you're scrubbing in to help cut me open somehow makes me even MORE nervous!!"
nodes.slv3a_061: Not the least bit surprised, Ryuji nodded readily:
nodes.slv3a_062: "Having Dr. Fujisaki—who knows the patient's entire history inside out—as first assistant couldn't make my job smoother. Hiroko is scheduled as scrub nurse tomorrow morning and Nurse Yoneda is circulating, so we'll have a rock-solid team."
nodes.slv3a_063: Moments later, an outpatient nurse leaned in at the doorway to call Yuko over to the corridor window to verify her admission wristband and evening ward bed. Glancing back over her shoulder every three steps, Yuko picked up her bag and followed the nurse out.
nodes.slv3a_064: For the moment, only the two doctors remained in the consultation room.
nodes.slv3a_065: Sliding Yuko's signed consent form neatly into her clipboard, Shiori didn't turn to leave right away. Instead, she lingered beside the desk, met Ryuji's eyes, and lowered her voice slightly.
nodes.slv3a_066: "Dr. Sakaguchi, regarding tomorrow's operation... I have one small personal request."
nodes.slv3a_068: Her fingers curled lightly along the edge of the chart folder; her tone remained polite and measured, though the faintest trace of self-consciousness tinted her fair earlobes.
nodes.slv3a_069: "Tomorrow morning once Yuko-chan enters the OR, I'd like to handle the routine initial prep—changing out of her clothes, getting her settled on the table, and placing the monitors—together with Nurse Yoneda and Nurse Sugimura. Until that part is finished, you don't need to step inside yet."
nodes.slv3a_070: Lifting her lashes, she added a quiet clarification, her gaze clear and earnest.
nodes.slv3a_071: "Please don't take it the wrong way—I trust your professionalism completely. It's only that... Yuko-chan is an old friend I've known since high school, and she's always cared deeply about appearances and saving face. Having to undress completely wide awake and climb onto an operating table with a male doctor watching from the very first minute would make her terribly self-conscious... Wherever I can spare her a little embarrassment, I'd like to look out for her."
nodes.slv3a_072: Understanding her thoughtfulness immediately and taking zero offense, Ryuji gave a clean nod.
nodes.slv3a_073: "That's completely human—it's always harder to relax around someone you already know. I'll leave the routine room-entry prep to you and the nurses and wait outside until you buzz me."
nodes.slv3a_074: Pausing there, Ryuji added one calm, matter-of-fact reminder as lead surgeon about the single step that couldn't be bypassed.
nodes.slv3a_075: "One thing does need to be clear up front, though—tomorrow's case is under spinal anesthesia. Under hospital OR protocol, the lumbar puncture, intrathecal injection, and the sensory-level check right afterward have to be performed by me in person, and none of that can be done through a curtain or under a heavy sheet."
nodes.slv3a_076: Shiori blinked slightly, her fingers pausing along the edge of the clipboard before she drew a quiet breath and nodded properly.
nodes.slv3a_077: "...Yes, I understand the protocol. For the spinal block and sensory testing tomorrow, we'll be counting on you, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.slv3a_078: At eight-thirty the next morning, the automatic doors of the operating room slid softly shut.
nodes.slv3a_079: Beside the instrument table, Hiroko Sugimura was methodically counting hemostats and retractors from the open appendectomy tray; meanwhile, beside the narrow black-leather operating table at the center of the room, Yuko Asahina—earrings removed and every lock of hair tucked inside an elastic blue bouffant cap—was blushing furiously as she slipped off her pale underwear and tucked it into the clothing basket held by circulating nurse Shiori Yoneda.
nodes.slv3a_080: "All set—I've stored your personal clothes safely in the locker. Watch your step on the footstool, Ms. Asahina, and lie right down on the operating table."
nodes.slv3a_081: "Uwah... prepping back on the ward was embarrassing enough, and now standing stark naked next to all these shiny metal trays feels like my heart's going to leap right out of my throat..."
nodes.slv3a_082: Shielding her chest with one arm and her upper thighs with the other, Yuko hurried barefoot up the step stool and lay back onto the cool table pad.
nodes.slv3a_083: Already scrubbed into green scrubs, cap, and mask beside the table, Shiori stepped forward at once. The moment Nurse Yoneda finished placing the chest ECG leads, clipping on the pulse oximeter, and quickly verifying the clean skin-prep zone from the right lower abdomen down to the suprapubic border, Shiori drew a warmed thin cotton sheet smoothly from below Yuko's collarbones all the way to her ankles—even tucking the hanging edges neatly beneath her sides.
nodes.slv3a_084: Watching her old classmate—only a pair of clear, earnest eyes visible above her mask—bundle her up as if guarding a fortress, Yuko, whose toes had been curled tight with nerves, burst out laughing.
nodes.slv3a_085: "Hey, Shiori... tucking the sheet in this tight makes me feel like a freshly wrapped spring roll! I can barely move my arms."
nodes.slv3a_086: Letting out a soft sigh behind her mask, Shiori reached over to tuck a stray wisp of hair at Yuko's temple back inside her blue patient cap.
nodes.slv3a_087: "The OR air-conditioning runs cool, so keeping covered keeps you from catching a chill. How are you feeling—looks like your heart rate has settled down a bit since you walked in?"
nodes.slv3a_088: "Yeah, having you right next to me helps a ton! And thank goodness it was just you, Ms. Hiroko, and little Yoneda handling the undressing and skin-prep check up front—if Dr. Sakaguchi had been standing right here watching me climb onto the table naked, doctor or not, I'd die of embarrassment if I ever bumped into him on the street after discharge!"
nodes.slv3a_089: Above her surgical mask, Shiori's eyes curved into a gentle smile:
nodes.slv3a_090: "I spoke with Dr. Sakaguchi yesterday, so he stayed outside for the routine room-entry prep—"
nodes.slv3a_091: Before her sentence had quite finished fading, Shiori Yoneda—having checked the monitor readings and spinal tray—turned around and spoke with textbook politeness.
nodes.slv3a_092: "Dr. Fujisaki, Ms. Asahina, the routine entry checklist is complete. I've buzzed Lead Surgeon Dr. Sakaguchi on the intercom to come administer the spinal block—Ms. Asahina, when we position you on your side for the spinal and test the anesthetic level right afterward, we'll need to take this thin sheet completely off so he can work."
nodes.slv3a_093: On the operating table, the "spring roll" froze solid.
nodes.slv3a_094: "...Eh?? W-wait a minute! Take the sheet ALL the way off?!"
nodes.slv3a_095: Yuko whipped her head toward Shiori at the bedside, her voice cracking:
nodes.slv3a_096: "Shiori!! Didn't you JUST say Dr. Sakaguchi wouldn't be handling the pre-op prep?!"
nodes.slv3a_097: Shiori's eyelashes fluttered; the faintest blush rose to the earlobes showing beneath her cap as she hurriedly steadied Yuko before she could pop upright.
nodes.slv3a_098: "All the other routine prep really IS finished... but spinal anesthesia is an anesthetic procedure performed by the lead surgeon. I'm an internist—I don't administer spinals, so Dr. Sakaguchi has to perform this step himself."
nodes.slv3a_099: "Then he's still going to see me stark naked in thirty seconds anyway?! How is that any different from him walking in at the start?!"
nodes.slv3a_100: Hiroko Sugimura (holding back a warm smile beside the instrument stand):
nodes.slv3a_101: "Hehe, at least you already breezed past the most awkward two minutes of taking off your underwear and climbing onto the table. There goes the door—Dr. Sakaguchi's coming in."
nodes.slv3a_102: The automatic door slid open and closed. Dressed in green scrubs, cap, and surgical mask, Ryuji strode up to the operating table, glanced at the slightly elevated heart rate on the monitor, and greeted Yuko warmly.
nodes.slv3a_103: "Good morning, Ms. Asahina. Did you get some sleep last night? Let's get your spinal anesthesia placed first—once it sets in, you won't feel any pain below the waist."
nodes.slv3a_104: Gripping the hem of the thin sheet, cheeks rosy red, Yuko answered in a small voice:
nodes.slv3a_105: "G-good morning, Dr. Sakaguchi... please go easy on me in a minute..."
nodes.slv3a_106: Walking over to the puncture cart, Ryuji peeled open a pair of sterile gloves and snapped them on. Circulating nurse Shiori Yoneda stepped to the table and briskly lifted the thin cotton sheet completely away, leaving the lumbar sterile prep zone and bony surface landmarks fully uncovered.
nodes.slv3a_107: As the cool OR air met her bare skin, Yuko drew a tiny breath and tensed from head to toe.
nodes.slv3a_108: "All right, Ms. Asahina—let Dr. Fujisaki guide you slowly onto your left side. Draw both knees up toward your stomach as far as you comfortably can, hug your knees, tuck your chin toward your chest, and arch your lower back out round like a shrimp."
nodes.slv3a_109: "Here, Yuko-chan—just rest your shoulder against my hand and roll slowly toward me..."
nodes.slv3a_110: Standing on the left side of the table, Shiori leaned in, supporting Yuko's cool shoulder with one hand while cradling the outside of her bent knees with the other.
nodes.slv3a_111: As Yuko bit her lip and curled onto her side beneath the crisp overhead lights, the clean curve from her pale shoulder blades and lightly rising waist down to the rounded arch of her hips and back of her thighs—drawn taut by hugging her knees—faced Ryuji on the right side of the table without a scrap of cover.
nodes.slv3a_112: Across the narrow operating table, Shiori bowed her head as she steadied Yuko's shoulder. Her gaze brushed briefly past the bare line of her old friend's waist and hip in front of Ryuji; her lashes stilled for a fraction of a second, and her fingers tightened imperceptibly on Yuko's shoulder as she quietly watched his every movement.
nodes.slv3a_113: Ryuji's expression stayed calm and matter-of-fact, his focus trained strictly on the lumbar anatomical landmarks. Stepping closer, he rested his sterile-gloved left hand firmly atop the crest of Yuko's right posterior superior iliac spine while his thumb palpated the lumbar interspinous spaces one vertebra at a time above the gluteal cleft.
nodes.slv3a_115: At the sudden touch of cool, smooth latex against the unguarded skin of her lower back and upper hip, Yuko jerked her shoulders inward like a startled cat, her spine nearly straightening.
nodes.slv3a_116: Across from him, Shiori snapped into focus at once, pressing gently against Yuko's shoulder and upper back in a warm but unmistakably doctorly tone.
nodes.slv3a_117: "Don't jump, Yuko-chan. He's palpating the space between your lumbar vertebrae right now—keep your back arched out round and hold the posture steady."
nodes.slv3a_118: Yuko Asahina (burying half her burning face into the crook of her arm with a muffled grumble):
nodes.slv3a_119: "Ugh... I-I know! Dr. Sakaguchi's glove was just freezing cold out of nowhere and startled me..."
nodes.slv3a_120: "Sorry about that—freshly opened gloves run a little cool. I've got the exact interspace marked. Next I'll swab antiseptic across your lower back, which will feel cool and wet too, so bear with me a moment."
nodes.slv3a_121: Picking up a large sponge soaked in amber-brown povidone-iodine, Ryuji painted outward in even concentric circles across Yuko's lower back down toward the upper gluteal cleft. As the cool solution spread along the groove of her spine, Yuko clung tight to Shiori's forearm, her long lashes trembling nonstop, yet she bit her lip dutifully without squirming once.
nodes.slv3a_122: "Very good—you're holding the position textbook-perfect. Now a tiny skin wheal of local anesthetic, just like a mosquito pinch—deep breath in."
nodes.slv3a_123: A fine needle raised a small intradermal wheal; switching smoothly to a fine-gauge spinal needle, Ryuji advanced along the L3–L4 interspace with steady fingertip control. Through the ligaments came the crisp, unmistakable pop through the dura mater, and when he withdrew the stylet, a single drop of crystal-clear cerebrospinal fluid welled at the hub.
nodes.slv3a_124: Attaching the syringe, Ryuji injected the spinal anesthetic at a slow, even pace.
nodes.slv3a_125: "You'll feel a mild heavy ache deep inside as the medication goes in—that's completely normal. Five more seconds and we're done."
nodes.slv3a_126: "Mmh... yeah, it feels like something warm is spreading deep inside my hips and upper thighs..."
nodes.slv3a_127: Needle withdrawn, gentle pressure with sterile gauze, a small transparent dressing smoothed neatly in place—the entire puncture and injection flowed from start to finish in barely two or three minutes without a single wasted motion.
nodes.slv3a_128: Across the table, watching Ryuji's clean, unhurried withdrawal of the needle, Shiori let the subtle tension above her mask quietly soften.
nodes.slv3a_129: Stripping off the puncture gloves into the disposal bin, Ryuji walked back around to the right side of the table and checked the clock.
nodes.slv3a_130: "Clean tap. While the block is settling into level, Dr. Fujisaki, Nurse Yoneda, please help Ms. Asahina roll gently onto her back so I can map the sensory block right away."
nodes.slv3a_131: "Right away, Dr. Sakaguchi! Easy now, Ms. Asahina—let your legs lengthen out slowly, I've got your ankles—"
nodes.slv3a_132: Because skin sensation had to be compared continuously from the upper chest downward right before abdominal prep and draping, the sheet was left off. Guided on either side by Shiori and Nurse Yoneda, Yuko uncurled her knees and rolled onto her back at the center of the pad while Yoneda rested both her arms comfortably along the padded armboards.
nodes.slv3a_133: Without the curled lateral posture to hide behind, everything from her collarbones and softly rising chest down across her smooth, flat abdomen to the tops of her closed thighs lay openly beneath the bright surgical ceiling lights.
nodes.slv3a_134: "Uu... lying flat on my back leaves even less room to hide... and my legs feel so heavy, like they barely listen to me anymore..."
nodes.slv3a_135: Standing at the left head of the table, Shiori had just finished straightening the thin pillow beneath Yuko's head. Glancing down at her wholly uncovered friend as Ryuji stepped up to the right rail holding forceps tipped with an alcohol swab, Shiori's fingers paused on the edge of the mattress for half a beat, her gaze slipping fractionally aside.
nodes.slv3a_136: Even so, she steadied herself at once and remained quietly at Yuko's left shoulder to observe—though the fair tips of her ears peeking beneath her blue surgical cap had already turned a soft shade of pink.
nodes.slv3a_137: Standing composedly at the right rail, Ryuji first touched the cool alcohol swab lightly against the skin just below Yuko's collarbone as an unblocked baseline reference.
nodes.slv3a_138: "No need to look down, Ms. Asahina—just tell me plainly what you feel. Right here below your collarbone, can you clearly feel how cold the alcohol swab is?"
nodes.slv3a_139: Yuko Asahina (staring tensely at the ceiling and nodding rapidly):
nodes.slv3a_140: "Y-yes, I feel it! Nice and cold, super clear!"
nodes.slv3a_141: Ryuji nodded and moved his wrist steadily downward, touching the alcohol swab below the xiphoid and costal margin, then around the umbilicus and across the planned right lower quadrant incision site before switching to smooth, blunt forceps to test a light pinch on the right lower abdominal skin.
nodes.slv3a_142: "And how about now? From around your navel down to the spot on your lower right abdomen I just pinched—does it feel cold or sharp at all?"
nodes.slv3a_143: Yuko blinked twice; her trembling shoulders sank back onto the pad in surprise.
nodes.slv3a_144: "Huh...? I can tell your hand and something touched my tummy... but it doesn't feel cold at all, and that pinch didn't hurt one bit—it's like somebody pressing through a super thick winter quilt!"
nodes.slv3a_145: Checking one last point just above the groin to confirm a symmetric, crisp block boundary, Ryuji set the testing forceps cleanly back into the kidney dish, glanced up at the steady blood pressure and heart rate on the monitor, and nodded to the team.
nodes.slv3a_146: "Good—sensory block is settled solidly below T8, more than enough coverage. Hiroko, Nurse Yoneda, go ahead with the abdominal skin prep and sterile fenestrated drapes while Dr. Fujisaki and I scrub and gown."
nodes.slv3a_147: "Understood, Dr. Sakaguchi—the prep tray and sterile fenestrated drapes are ready."
nodes.slv3a_148: Hearing "more than enough coverage" and realizing nothing hurt at all, Yuko finally let out the long breath she had been holding all morning.
nodes.slv3a_149: With the knot of fear melting away, Shiori's outspoken old classmate tilted her head on the pillow toward Ryuji—standing on the right side of the table in full surgical cap and mask with only a pair of calm, attentive eyes showing—and suddenly curved her eyes into a heartfelt smile:
nodes.slv3a_150: "Dr. Sakaguchi, I can't see your whole face under the mask, but your hands are so gentle—it feels really dashing, honestly."
nodes.slv3a_151: For half a second, the crisp, orderly air of the operating room went dead quiet.
nodes.slv3a_152: At the left head of the table, Shiori's fingertips stiffened, her clear eyes widening above her mask. Her gaze darted reflexively between Ryuji and Yuko before snapping away as if scalded—both ears outside her surgical cap, along with the small strip of fair cheek visible beside her mask, turning crimson in the blink of an eye.
nodes.slv3a_153: "Y-Yuko-chan! We are in the middle of an operating room...!"
nodes.slv3a_154: On the table, Yuko blinked up at her in pure innocence.
nodes.slv3a_155: "I know we're in an operating room! My lower half's numb and I didn't budge an inch—surely giving my lead surgeon an honest compliment isn't against hospital rules... Huh? Shiori, why did your ears turn bright red all of a sudden?"
nodes.slv3a_156: Angling her masked face another half-inch toward the monitor bank and away from Ryuji across the table, Shiori spoke half a beat faster than usual.
nodes.slv3a_157: "...It's nothing. The overhead surgical lamps must be running a little warm."
nodes.slv3a_158: "Really? I'm lying here without a stitch on and it feels plenty cool to me..."
nodes.slv3a_159: Beside the instrument stand, Hiroko's eyes curved into a warm, knowing smile above her mask—whereas circulating nurse Shiori Yoneda earnestly turned to check the digital wall hygrometer and reported straight-faced:
nodes.slv3a_160: "Um... Dr. Fujisaki, the air-conditioning isn't malfunctioning—room temperature is holding steady at exactly twenty-two degrees Celsius."
nodes.slv3a_161: "...Nurse Yoneda, you didn't need to read out the exact number! Dr. Sakaguchi, since the block is confirmed, l-let's head to the scrub sink and gown up!"
nodes.slv3a_162: Watching Dr. Fujisaki practically march toward the scrub bay on matching left-foot left-arm strides, Ryuji let a quiet smile cross his eyes, told Yuko gently to "rest easy for a moment, we'll get started shortly," and followed Shiori out to scrub.
nodes.slv3a_163: Ten minutes later, the overhead halogen shadowless lamps flooded the operating table in crisp, brilliant light.
nodes.slv3a_164: Wide povidone-iodine prep of the right lower quadrant was complete; heavy forest-green sterile cotton drapes covered Yuko securely, with an anesthesia screen raised at her head to block direct view of the operative field.
nodes.slv3a_165: Stepping back into the first-assistant position across the screen, Shiori wore a full forest-green sterile surgical gown, both hands clad in snug sterile latex gloves held poised before her chest.
nodes.slv3a_166: Though her ears had been burning crimson minutes ago, the instant she stepped onto the foot platform and lowered her eyes to the right lower quadrant incision window, every trace of fluster vanished—leaving only calm, focused clinical poise.
nodes.slv3a_167: "Lead surgeon and first assistant in position. Pre-incision instrument and sponge count verified."
nodes.slv3a_168: "Blood pressure 115 over 72, heart rate 78, SpO2 99 percent—all vitals steady!"
nodes.slv3a_169: Shiori Fujisaki (aligning sterile retractors and gauze with steady hands, her voice crisp and composed):
nodes.slv3a_170: "Suction and retractors ready. Ready for skin incision whenever you are, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.slv3a_171: From behind the anesthesia screen at the head of the table came Yuko's voice, half nervous and half hyping herself up.
nodes.slv3a_172: "Uu... not being able to see anything behind this curtain makes it feel like opening a mystery box... Dr. Sakaguchi, Shiori—I'm leaving my tummy in your hands!"
nodes.slv3a_175: Snipping the final skin suture, Hiroko smoothly dressed the neat, clean little incision in the right lower quadrant with a sterile pad.
nodes.slv3a_176: Nearby in the specimen basin lay the swollen, congested appendix—matching Shiori's outpatient targeted-ultrasound reading down to the millimeter, with a soybean-sized hardened fecalith wedged fast inside the proximal lumen and unmistakable signs of recurrent chronic mucosal inflammation, thankfully removed before perforation could touch the peritoneal cavity.
nodes.slv3a_177: "Instruments, needles, sponges, and saline laparotomy pads counted twice—all counts correct."
nodes.slv3a_178: Shiori Fujisaki (relaxing her wrist off the clamp and meeting Ryuji's eyes across the table, genuine relief warming her gaze above her mask):
nodes.slv3a_179: "Estimated blood loss under twenty milliliters, and the cecal serosa was kept spotless. Thank you for the smooth work, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.slv3a_180: "Your retractor exposure was rock-steady, Dr. Fujisaki—saved me plenty of trouble finding the appendiceal base."
nodes.slv3a_181: Behind the head drape, catching the two doctors' exchange, Yuko eagerly craned her chin upward.
nodes.slv3a_182: "I-is it over?! Halfway through it felt like somebody was tugging around inside my belly—I thought you guys were playing tug-of-war in there... Am I really all stitched up?!"
nodes.slv3a_183: Shiori Fujisaki (stepping around the anesthesia frame to Yuko's head and leaning down gently):
nodes.slv3a_184: "Everything's completely finished, Yuko-chan. Both that stubborn stone and the inflamed appendix came out cleanly—you won't ever have to worry about sudden midnight stomach pain again."
nodes.slv3a_185: By three-thirty that afternoon, most of the spinal numbness had worn off. When Ryuji and Shiori walked side by side into the third-floor surgical ward for afternoon rounds, Yuko was propped comfortably against her pillow with one hand resting atop the blanket, looking livelier than expected.
nodes.slv3a_186: Checking her bedside vitals sheet and the clean surgical dressing, Ryuji gave an approving nod.
nodes.slv3a_187: "Temperature is normal, and the incision dressing is completely dry. Now that the block has worn off, how's the soreness on your right side?"
nodes.slv3a_188: "There's a dull little ache, sure, but compared to twisting around in pain at midnight before, this is totally manageable! Dr. Sakaguchi, thank you so, so much on the operating table this morning."
nodes.slv3a_189: Having thanked him, Yuko rolled her eyes sideways toward Shiori—who was adjusting the drip rate on her IV stand beside the bed—narrowed her gaze, and let out a theatrical sigh.
nodes.slv3a_190: "As for a certain great Dr. Fujisaki, though... lying here thinking all afternoon, something started feeling mighty suspicious."
nodes.slv3a_191: Shiori's fingers paused on the roller clamp, and she blinked in honest confusion.
nodes.slv3a_192: "Suspicious? Are you feeling nauseated, or is the puncture spot on your lower back aching?"
nodes.slv3a_193: "Neither! I mean yesterday afternoon in the clinic—didn't you pat my hand and promise you'd stay right beside me in the OR to protect me the whole time?!"
nodes.slv3a_195: "The operation went smoothly, and I stayed right at your side from start to finish without leaving once."
nodes.slv3a_196: "Well, technically yes!! Except when little Yoneda came by earlier to check my blood pressure, she gushed about you with stars in her eyes—saying 'Dr. Fujisaki held the retractors so steadily and wide open today, keeping the incision crystal clear!'—Shiori, while Dr. Sakaguchi was cutting me open, were YOU personally pulling my belly apart with metal hooks?!"
nodes.slv3a_197: Beside her, the corner of Ryuji's mouth curved ever so slightly.
nodes.slv3a_198: A helpless flush rose across Shiori's fair cheeks; clearing her throat lightly, she did her best to maintain her dignified attending composure.
nodes.slv3a_199: "...'Pulling you apart' makes it sound barbaric! It's called retracting for surgical exposure, which is literally the first assistant's job! If I hadn't held the field steady, how was Dr. Sakaguchi supposed to remove that troublemaking appendix so quickly?"
nodes.slv3a_200: "Uwah—one minute my old classmate is blushing while wrapping me up like a spring roll, and the second she puts on a green gown and grabs metal hooks she turns ice-cold... Doctors flip their switches way too fast!"
nodes.slv3a_201: For all her lively teasing, as Yuko looked from a slightly flustered Shiori to Ryuji's calm smile beside the bed, her eyes softened into a radiant, heartfelt grin.
nodes.slv3a_202: "Seriously though, knowing that ticking time bomb inside my stomach was defused by the two of you together makes me feel safer than I have in months! Shiori, Dr. Sakaguchi—once I recover in a couple of days, get discharged, and come back to the clinic to get my stitches out, I'm picking a fantastic spot and taking my two lifesavers out to a proper thank-you dinner!"
nodes.slv3a_203: Glancing briefly at Ryuji beside her, Shiori let her eyes curve into a warm smile.
nodes.slv3a_204: "We'll talk about dinner after your follow-up and suture removal. Tonight you lie flat and rest like a good patient—no daydreaming about restaurant menus until bowel sounds are back."
nodes.slv3a_205: "Yes, ma'am, yes, ma'am—this time I'll be the most obedient model patient in the whole hospital!"
nodes.slv3a_206: Warm afternoon sunlight spilled across the crisp ward sheets. Having confirmed Yuko was recovering smoothly, Ryuji and Shiori exchanged a quiet smile and walked out of the room side by side.

part_b.title: Dinner for Four and the Walk Home
part_b.teaser: Back at the outpatient clinic fully recovered for suture removal, Yuko Asahina invites you and Shiori Fujisaki to a cozy wood-fired trattoria—and two evenings later under the warm alley lamps, Shiori brings along their gentle, bashful high-school friend Megumi Mikihara.
part_b.gallery_caption: Laughter for four inside the wood-fired trattoria, a quiet tree-lined walk side by side, and a soft goodnight beneath the amber glow of Shiori's apartment porch.

choices.choice_slv3b_024_a: "If it's a casual get-together as 'Dr. Fujisaki's old friend' rather than a thank-you gift for a doctor, I'd be glad to join."
choices.choice_slv3b_024_b: "Put it like that and turning you down would just be stiff of me. Count me in for the evening after tomorrow."
choices.choice_slv3b_080_a: "I can vouch for her—the moment Dr. Fujisaki picked up the retractors, nobody in that room was calmer or more professional."
choices.choice_slv3b_080_b: "Sounds like Ms. Asahina really has made a full recovery if she remembers every detail at the table that clearly."
choices.choice_slv3b_147_a: "Honestly, turning into a flawless hundred-point adult who never gets flustered would make everyday company a lot less fun."
choices.choice_slv3b_147_b: "Looks like the two of them dashing off for limited-edition chestnut cake handed me a pretty nice evening walk for free."

nodes.slv3b_001: At four-thirty in the afternoon, the faint scent of medical alcohol hung in the air of the outpatient surgical dressing room.
nodes.slv3b_002: Stripping off his exam gloves into the disposal bin, Ryuji smoothed one last thin, breathable gauze strip over the healed incision for Yuko Asahina as she sat on the edge of the exam couch.
nodes.slv3b_003: "All the sutures are cleanly out. The incision has healed flat with zero redness or seepage—you're clear for normal showers starting tomorrow, and everyday work or shopping won't be a problem at all."
nodes.slv3b_004: Smoothing down the hem of her knit cardigan, Yuko hopped lightly off the exam table, spun half a circle in place to test her waist, and beamed with pure relief.
nodes.slv3b_005: "Awesome!! While resting at home the past few days after discharge I barely dared take big steps, and now that the stitches are out I finally feel 100 percent alive again!"
nodes.slv3b_006: Standing nearby, Shiori watched her whirlwind of an old classmate with warmly curved eyes.
nodes.slv3b_007: "Even with the stitches out, don't spin quite that fast. Seeing your color back like this—and that you even picked out your lipstick shade carefully today—means I can finally stop worrying."
nodes.slv3b_008: "Hehe, it's my grand graduation day from follow-ups, after all! Oh, right, Dr. Sakaguchi—now that that pesky stone and my appendix are both gone and the stitches are out, I shouldn't ever have to lie on an operating table again, right?"
nodes.slv3b_009: Signing off on her outpatient follow-up slip, Ryuji glanced up and paused half a beat with the faintest trace of amusement.
nodes.slv3b_010: "You definitely won't grow a second appendix. As for everything else, well, for now—"
nodes.slv3b_011: "STOP, STOP, STOP!! Dr. Sakaguchi, I am begging you, please never say the words 'for now' around me ever again!! Just hearing those two words makes the right side of my stomach tense up on reflex!"
nodes.slv3b_012: Shiori couldn't hold back a soft laugh behind her fingers.
nodes.slv3b_013: Laughing aside, after tucking away her follow-up receipt, Yuko didn't head straight for the door. Hugging her stylish handbag in front of her, she let her expression turn earnest and looked up at both doctors.
nodes.slv3b_014: "All right, down to business! Back on the ward I promised that once I got discharged and came back to get my stitches out, I'd thank the two of you properly."
nodes.slv3b_015: Pulling her phone from her bag, she tapped the screen awake and held up a bookmarked neighborhood restaurant page, her tone bright and sincere.
nodes.slv3b_016: "Are the two of you free around six-thirty the evening after tomorrow once your shifts wrap up? Tucked in a side lane off the west entrance of the shopping arcade, there's a cozy little trattoria known for wood-fired dishes and handmade pasta—nothing outrageously pricey or stiff, just a relaxed spot with great word of mouth lately. I'd love to treat Shiori and Dr. Sakaguchi to dinner!"
nodes.slv3b_017: Clicking his fountain-pen cap shut, Ryuji paused slightly with polite professional hesitation.
nodes.slv3b_018: "I appreciate the thought wholeheartedly, Ms. Asahina. Still, getting a patient healthy again is simply a surgeon's job—having someone freshly discharged go out of her way to treat her lead surgeon to dinner feels a little awkward as a matter of professional boundaries."
nodes.slv3b_019: Before Yuko could even wave her hands in protest, Shiori turned smoothly toward Ryuji beside her and spoke in a calm, candid voice.
nodes.slv3b_020: "If she were still under inpatient care, or offering a gift with strings attached, then as doctors we would naturally decline."
nodes.slv3b_021: She glanced warmly at her hopeful old classmate before meeting Ryuji's eyes with measured, persuasive grace.
nodes.slv3b_022: "Here, though, Dr. Sakaguchi, Yuko is also a dear friend I've known for years. While she was admitted here, we treated her strictly as a patient; now that she's completed every step of treatment and been discharged in full health, we shouldn't keep reducing her only to 'a patient' forever and deny a friend the chance to share a normal casual meal and say thank you, should we?"
nodes.slv3b_023: Nodding vigorously, Yuko planted both hands on her hips in righteous agreement.
nodes.slv3b_024: "Exactly, Dr. Sakaguchi! I was properly discharged, got my stitches out today, and earned my clean bill of health fair and square—it's not like I climbed over the hospital wall at midnight! Besides, prices there are super reasonable; it's purely friends getting together to celebrate me being back at full strength!"
nodes.slv3b_025: Looking at the seamless double-act in front of him, Ryuji gave a wry, good-natured smile.
nodes.slv3b_026: "When Dr. Fujisaki puts it like that, it clears up my hesitation nicely. So long as we're gathering as old friends rather than making it a special thank-you gift for a surgeon, I'll gladly accept."
nodes.slv3b_028: "Yes! Zero medical charts at the dinner table—just good food!"
nodes.slv3b_029: Shiori's brows relaxed softly as she gave a gentle nod:
nodes.slv3b_030: "I don't have a night shift the evening after tomorrow either, so the timing works out nicely."
nodes.slv3b_031: Shaking his head with a quiet laugh, Ryuji lowered his clipboard.
nodes.slv3b_032: "When the two of you make a case that thorough, standing on ceremony as a doctor would just make me inflexible. Six-thirty the evening after tomorrow, right? Count me in."
nodes.slv3b_033: Yuko's eyes curved into delighted crescents:
nodes.slv3b_034: "Yay! I knew Dr. Sakaguchi wasn't some stuffy textbook stickler!"
nodes.slv3b_035: Beside her, Shiori let out a quiet breath too, a soft smile touching her lips:
nodes.slv3b_037: "Awesome—I'll call the restaurant right now to hold a table! I'll text the address to Shiori's phone in a bit. Six-thirty the evening after tomorrow right outside the trattoria—don't be late!"
nodes.slv3b_038: After waving off a light-footed Yuko, Shiori paused by the consultation-room door to glance down at the map pin that had just popped onto her screen. Her fingers lingered along the edge of her phone for a heartbeat; blinking once without adding anything further, she simply offered Ryuji a gentle "See you the evening after tomorrow."
nodes.slv3b_039: At six twenty-five two evenings later, the last glow of sunset had just dipped behind the eaves, and the side lane off the west shopping arcade drifted with the warm aroma of wood-roasted rosemary, olive oil, and fresh dough.
nodes.slv3b_040: Turning into the lane with the address in hand, Ryuji spotted three young women standing beneath the warm amber wall lamp outside the red-brick trattoria and its chalkboard menu.
nodes.slv3b_041: Alongside Yuko—who was pointing animatedly at the pastry shelf through the window—and Shiori, dressed in a cream tweed jacket and a deep navy satin headband accented with tiny pearls, stood a quiet young woman with soft bobbed hair and a pale apricot cardigan.
nodes.slv3b_042: Catching the sound of footsteps first, Shiori turned her head and spotted Ryuji approaching.
nodes.slv3b_043: Stepping half a pace forward noticeably quicker than her usual unhurried hospital stride, she gestured politely toward the short-haired woman beside her before Yuko could jump in, introducing her in a slightly brisk yet impeccably courteous voice.
nodes.slv3b_044: "Ah—good evening, Dr. Sakaguchi! Um... besides Yuko-chan tonight, I also invited another close friend of ours from high school—Megumi Mikihara. They'd been saying it had been ages since the three of us sat down for dinner together, and since tonight's a casual gathering among friends, I thought sitting around a table of four would make conversation livelier and more relaxed for everyone..."
nodes.slv3b_045: Half a step behind Shiori's shoulder, Megumi Mikihara stiffened slightly at the sound of her name. Stealing one quick upward glance at the tall, composed surgeon before her, her fair cheeks flushed pink at once; clutching her handbag strap with both hands, she gave a neat, earnest bow and spoke in a soft, gentle voice.
nodes.slv3b_046: "G-good evening, Dr. Sakaguchi...! I'm Megumi Mikihara, a classmate of Shiori and Yuko-chan's... Shiori told me how wonderfully you looked after Yuko-chan the other day—p-please excuse me for tagging along tonight..."
nodes.slv3b_047: Coming to a stop, Ryuji returned her bow with an easy, unhurried nod, keeping his voice calm and welcoming.
nodes.slv3b_048: "Good to meet you, Ms. Mikihara—I'm Ryuji Sakaguchi. No need to be formal at all; having more company makes dinner all the nicer."
nodes.slv3b_049: Folding her arms beside them, Yuko let her lively gaze dart back and forth between Ryuji and Shiori before settling on Shiori's carefully chosen navy pearl headband and earnest profile, her lips curling into a teasing grin.
nodes.slv3b_050: "Ohhh, sure, that's true enough. Though when Shiori texted me out of the blue yesterday at noon asking 'Mind if we invite Megumi along too?' and sent two follow-up messages confirming the time, I couldn't help wondering since when our Attending Dr. Fujisaki got so eager to organize group dinners~"
nodes.slv3b_051: Shiori's long lashes flickered; the faintest warmth touched the tips of her ears. Clearing her throat lightly as if nothing had happened, she turned and pushed open the wood-framed glass door of the trattoria.
nodes.slv3b_052: "...Because their four-person booths happen to be much roomier, that's all. The breeze is picking up at the mouth of the lane and we're right on time for the reservation, so let's head inside."
nodes.slv3b_053: Yuko Asahina (beaming as she hooked her arm around Megumi's elbow to follow):
nodes.slv3b_054: "Come on, come on, Megumi—dinner's on me tonight, so let's try their signature wood-fired dishes!"
nodes.slv3b_055: Stepping inside, the server led the four of them to a quiet, spacious natural-wood booth tucked beside a corner window.
nodes.slv3b_056: Before anyone could sort out seating etiquette, Yuko deftly whisked Megumi onto the two-person bench along the window side:
nodes.slv3b_057: "Right this way—Megumi gets the cozy window spot inside, and I'll sit next to you so ordering's easy!"
nodes.slv3b_058: Glancing at the two seats remaining side by side on the opposite bench, Shiori's step stilled for half a second before she smoothed her skirt with practiced poise and slid into the inner seat—leaving a neat, proper fist's width of space between herself and Ryuji as he sat down on the aisle side.
nodes.slv3b_059: Taking the handwritten blackboard menu from the server—free at last of hospital gowns—Yuko slipped effortlessly back into her element, ordering wood-roasted seasonal vegetables, rosemary spring chicken, handmade clam pasta, and a crisp pitcher of elderflower sparkling fruit spritzer in one smooth breath.
nodes.slv3b_060: "Since both our star doctors have clinic shifts tomorrow, we'll skip alcohol tonight and toast with sparkling fruit spritzers instead—here's to my stomach staying safe and sound! Cheers!"
nodes.slv3b_061: Beneath the warm amber pendant lamp, four glasses met with a clear, cheerful clink.
nodes.slv3b_062: For the first few minutes, Megumi—seated diagonally across from Ryuji—remained a little shy, keeping her eyes lowered even while serving roasted vegetables with the shared spoon. Noticing the small bread basket at the corner of the table was just out of her reach, Ryuji casually slid both the basket and butter dish half an inch closer to the center without making a fuss, turning the conversation easily toward Yuko about the restaurant's wood-fired oven.
nodes.slv3b_063: Catching Ryuji's understated gesture out of the corner of her eye, a quiet warmth crossed Shiori's gaze as she plated a small portion of pasta cooled just right and set it in front of Megumi.
nodes.slv3b_064: "Try some of this, Megumi—it has the fresh basil leaves you like."
nodes.slv3b_065: Megumi Mikihara (curving her eyes gratefully as her shoulders finally relaxed):
nodes.slv3b_066: "Mm, thank you, Shiori... Oh, the pasta has such a wonderful bite—it's really delicious."
nodes.slv3b_067: With her two longtime friends trading easy banter beside her, Megumi's tense shoulders soon melted away. Before long, talk around the table flowed from work updates and this autumn's trending colors straight back to high-school walks home—like every time Yuko swore she was "just peeking at a brand-new dessert window" and dragged Shiori and Megumi into a forty-minute line, or how Megumi used to bake little cookies before exam week and slip them into their schoolbags.
nodes.slv3b_068: Out of her crisp white hospital coat and seated beneath the warm table lamp, Shiori carried none of the distance of an attending physician. Watching Yuko reenact old mishaps with theatrical hand gestures, she covered the corner of her mouth with the back of her hand and laughed aloud more than once, occasionally slipping in a gentle remark that punctured Yuko's tall tales.
nodes.slv3b_069: "That day in the crepe line, Yuko-chan spent five whole minutes agonizing at the counter between strawberry and banana-chocolate, then blamed the sun for setting too fast on the walk home."
nodes.slv3b_070: "Hey, hey, Shiori—leave my sophisticated city-girl image intact in front of Dr. Sakaguchi, won't you?!"
nodes.slv3b_071: Swallowing a bite of roast chicken, Yuko rolled her eyes mischievously, nudged Megumi's elbow beside her, and steered the conversation straight back to last week's operating room.
nodes.slv3b_072: "Seriously though, Megumi, it's almost a shame you didn't visit the ward—you should've seen how cool Dr. Sakaguchi and Shiori looked teaming up at the operating table! My legs were shaking at first, and then when Dr. Sakaguchi tested the anesthetic block for me, his hands were so steady and gentle that the fear vanished on the spot."
nodes.slv3b_073: Cupping her glass in both hands, Megumi blinked and murmured in quiet admiration:
nodes.slv3b_074: "Wow... just hearing Yuko-chan describe it makes Dr. Sakaguchi sound so dependable..."
nodes.slv3b_075: "Right?! Except the best part came right after that—I was lying on the table and casually complimented Dr. Sakaguchi for having gentle, dashing hands, and guess what happened? Shiori standing next to me nearly bit her tongue, both ears sticking out of her surgical cap turned beet red in one second flat, and when she tried to claim the OR lamps were running hot, the young circulating nurse turned around and announced, 'Room temperature is holding at twenty-two degrees sharp!'"
nodes.slv3b_077: Halfway through slicing a piece of spring chicken, Shiori's fork stilled, a visible flush rising across her fair cheeks.
nodes.slv3b_078: Across the table, Megumi's eyes widened slightly; looking from a rosy-cheeked Shiori to a shy quick glance at Ryuji beside her, she let out an honest little murmur of wonder.
nodes.slv3b_079: "Eh... even Shiori gets flustered like that? Back at school, no matter what happened, Shiori was always the calmest, most composed person in the room..."
nodes.slv3b_080: "Megumi, not you joining in with Yuko-chan too...! Th-that day the collar on my scrub top was just tied a little tight and felt stuffy, that's all!"
nodes.slv3b_081: Taking a sip of sparkling water, Ryuji offered a fair word on behalf of the partner seated beside him.
nodes.slv3b_082: "I can vouch for her on that count. Leaving those two minutes aside, the instant the shadowless lamps came on and Dr. Fujisaki picked up the retractors, her hands didn't waver half a millimeter—she was every inch a pro."
nodes.slv3b_083: Propping her chin in her palm, Yuko clicked her tongue in delight:
nodes.slv3b_084: "Look, look, Megumi—hear that? Our two doctors are even backing each other up at the dinner table!"
nodes.slv3b_085: Letting out a quiet breath, Shiori glanced sideways at Ryuji with a soft look half grateful and half abashed:
nodes.slv3b_086: "...Thank you for clearing my name, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.slv3b_087: The corner of Ryuji's mouth curved upward as he offered the beaming Yuko a light quip.
nodes.slv3b_088: "Sounds like Ms. Asahina really has made a thorough recovery—for someone squeezing her eyes shut with nerves at the time, she didn't miss a single thing around the table."
nodes.slv3b_090: "Well, obviously! It was spinal anesthesia, so my ears were wide awake!"
nodes.slv3b_091: Casting a helpless sidelong glance at the two of them, tips of her ears faintly pink, Shiori nudged the platter of roasted vegetables closer to Yuko:
nodes.slv3b_092: "...Now even Dr. Sakaguchi is teasing me. Your food's going to get cold—eat up already."
nodes.slv3b_093: Knowing just when to let a joke land without overplaying it, Yuko cheerfully invited Megumi to split the freshly served lemon sorbet.
nodes.slv3b_094: Outside the window, night deepened bit by bit while gentle acoustic guitar music drifted through the trattoria. Cradling a warm cup of black tea, Shiori listened quietly as her longtime friends and her colleague chatted around the same table, a soft curve lingering on her lips that was rarely seen inside the hospital.
nodes.slv3b_095: At eight-fifteen, after Yuko insisted on settling the check at the register just as promised, the four of them pushed open the wood-framed glass door and stepped back outside.
nodes.slv3b_096: An evening breeze swept past the mouth of the lane, carrying the crisp coolness of an autumn night.
nodes.slv3b_097: "Thank you for treating us tonight, Yuko-chan—the pasta and wood-roasted dishes really were wonderful."
nodes.slv3b_098: "Seeing everyone enjoy the food makes me super proud! That's one big thank-you off my chest at last—"
nodes.slv3b_099: Halfway through her sentence beneath the streetlamp, Yuko's lively gaze swept quietly across Shiori and Ryuji standing side by side.
nodes.slv3b_100: The next second, angling half her face out of Shiori's line of sight, Yuko shot Megumi a quick wink with her left eye and tilted her chin ever so slightly toward the west subway entrance.
nodes.slv3b_101: Megumi blinked first; following Yuko's glance toward Shiori, her fair cheeks flared crimson all the way to her ears. Catching her friend's meaning right away, however, she gripped her handbag strap, summoned her courage, and gave a tiny nod.
nodes.slv3b_102: Yuko Asahina (clapping her hands together abruptly as she gasped at the clock on her phone):
nodes.slv3b_103: "Ack, shoot! Megumi, doesn't that seasonal chestnut Mont Blanc counter on the basement floor of the station department store start closing up at eight-thirty?!"
nodes.slv3b_104: Megumi Mikihara (eyes darting sideways in a fluster as she nodded furiously on cue):
nodes.slv3b_105: "Eh? Ah... y-yes! That's right! Today's even the last day of their pop-up booth... if we don't hurry over to get in line right now, they'll definitely sell out!"
nodes.slv3b_107: "Huh? Five minutes ago over lemon sorbet, weren't the two of you patting your stomachs saying you couldn't fit another bite of sweets tonight—"
nodes.slv3b_108: Giving Attending Physician Fujisaki zero time to apply clinical logic, Yuko beamed, hooked her arm firmly through Megumi's, and backed two brisk steps toward the brightly lit subway entrance to the west.
nodes.slv3b_109: "Come on, dinner stomach and take-home-for-tomorrow's-breakfast dessert stomach are two separate compartments! The two of us have to dash before the last two boxes are gone—Dr. Sakaguchi, Shiori's apartment is right down that quiet street to the east, so since it's late, we're counting on you to walk our Shiori home!"
nodes.slv3b_110: Megumi Mikihara (bowing hurriedly toward the two of them with glowing red cheeks):
nodes.slv3b_111: "Thank you so much for tonight, Dr. Sakaguchi! Shiori, w-we'll text you tomorrow!"
nodes.slv3b_112: "Bye-bye—take your time, you two, don't bother seeing us off!"
nodes.slv3b_114: Shiori had barely lifted her hand halfway before her two remarkably coordinated old classmates trotted off into the arcade crowd and vanished down the illuminated stairwell of the subway station.
nodes.slv3b_115: All at once, beneath the quiet streetlamp at the mouth of the lane, only Shiori Fujisaki and Ryuji Sakaguchi remained.
nodes.slv3b_116: Slowly lowering her half-raised hand, Shiori stared after the corner where the pair had disappeared for two seconds; a faint warmth rose across her fair cheeks, and she let out a soft, helpless sigh.
nodes.slv3b_117: "...Honestly, Yuko is incorrigible—now she's even taught sweet, honest Megumi to put on a skit with her."
nodes.slv3b_118: Standing a pace beside her and watching her wry expression, Ryuji spoke gently.
nodes.slv3b_119: "The three of you really are close. Is that street to the east far from here?"
nodes.slv3b_120: Making no move to chase after the pair who were already long gone, Shiori tucked a lock of long hair behind her ear in the night breeze, paused a moment, and turned her eyes up toward Ryuji, her voice softer than it had been at the table.
nodes.slv3b_121: "About fifteen minutes on foot. If you aren't in a rush to get back tonight... would you mind walking part of the way with me, Dr. Sakaguchi?"
nodes.slv3b_122: "Not in a rush at all. Let's go—after a full dinner, an unhurried walk sounds just right."
nodes.slv3b_123: The slight tension at the corner of Shiori's lips eased into a quiet, gentle smile:
nodes.slv3b_125: Once they rounded the second corner, the neon signs and traffic hum of the shopping arcade faded far behind them.
nodes.slv3b_126: Tall street trees lined both sides of the flat stone walkway, where warm amber streetlamps cast pools of soft light every dozen meters, stretching and shortening their side-by-side shadows in unhurried rhythm.
nodes.slv3b_127: "I could tell back at the table—even though Ms. Mikihara and Ms. Asahina have completely opposite personalities, when the three of you sit together, your rhythm fits effortlessly."
nodes.slv3b_128: Folding both hands lightly over the strap of her small handbag in front of her, Shiori walked along the edge of the fallen leaves, a note of fond nostalgia warming her voice.
nodes.slv3b_129: "It really does. Around men she doesn't know well, Megumi gets nervous in an instant and her voice drops to half volume, yet in private she's the most attentive, kindhearted person imaginable; and Yuko-chan acts breezy and carefree, yet at every gathering she's the one making sure nobody feels left out... Even though high-school graduation was years ago now, sitting around that table tonight made it feel, just for a moment, like we'd barely finished evening study hall."
nodes.slv3b_130: Glancing sideways at Ryuji beside her, she asked naturally.
nodes.slv3b_131: "What about you, Dr. Sakaguchi? Do you still keep in close touch with your old classmates from school?"
nodes.slv3b_132: "Most of my medical-school classmates scattered to hospitals in different cities, and since I spent time overseas before coming here, it's mostly holiday messages now and then. Having longtime friends in the same city whom you can call out for a casual dinner anytime is honestly enviable."
nodes.slv3b_133: "It really is lucky that both of them ended up working around here. Back when we first started university and everyone was swamped in different places, we went quite a long stretch without seeing much of each other too."
nodes.slv3b_134: A night breeze rustled softly through the treetops overhead. Following the thread of their high-school years, Ryuji asked an easy, unhurried question.
nodes.slv3b_135: "Besides Ms. Asahina and Ms. Mikihara, did you have any other close friends back in high school?"
nodes.slv3b_136: Keeping an even pace along the stone path, her gaze resting on the lamplit corner ahead, Shiori answered with natural candor.
nodes.slv3b_137: "I did. There was a boy who lived right next door to my family—we knew each other from when we were very small."
nodes.slv3b_139: "Mm. Our parents already knew each other well, so growing up we often walked the same road to and from school. During our three years of high school, whenever a free holiday lined up, we went out together a few times too—to concerts, art museums, or walks along the seaside park."
nodes.slv3b_140: Glancing sideways at her, Ryuji remarked in a calm, conversational tone:
nodes.slv3b_141: "Sounds like high-school dates, more or less?"
nodes.slv3b_142: Shiori's step slowed by the faintest fraction; touching her fingertips lightly to the satin headband in her hair, she let a gentle, wistful smile cross her lips.
nodes.slv3b_143: "...Hehe, maybe they were. That was a very long time ago now."
nodes.slv3b_144: Drawing in a breath of cool night air, she brought her eyes back to the stone walkway ahead and the man walking steadily beside her, her expression clearer and softer than before.
nodes.slv3b_145: "Back in high school, I always assumed that once I turned twenty-five and put on a white coat, I'd naturally become the kind of composed, grown-up woman who handles every situation effortlessly without a single moment of hesitation."
nodes.slv3b_146: Tilting her face slightly toward Ryuji, her eyes caught the warm flecks of streetlamp glow.
nodes.slv3b_147: "Yet once I actually started working, I realized I still lose my footing around old friends out of nowhere, and still get caught off guard when classmates conspire to strand me on a street corner... Funny enough, though, walking home with you like this tonight doesn't feel awkward at all—in fact, it feels far easier than I expected."
nodes.slv3b_148: Easing his pace half a beat to match hers, Ryuji answered in a plain, steady voice.
nodes.slv3b_149: "If someone really stayed a flawless hundred-point adult every waking minute, not only would it wear her out, everyone around her would probably feel pressured too. Seeing Dr. Fujisaki occasionally stumped by her friends like tonight is plenty nice as it is."
nodes.slv3b_150: Shiori blinked once, then lowered her gaze with a quiet laugh, even her footsteps seeming lighter.
nodes.slv3b_151: "...Whenever you say something, Dr. Sakaguchi, you have a knack for letting people drop the tension in their shoulders."
nodes.slv3b_152: Looking ahead down the quiet lamplit lane, Ryuji let the corner of his mouth curve lightly.
nodes.slv3b_153: "Put it that way, and the two of them suddenly dashing off after limited-edition chestnut cake handed me a remarkably pleasant walk for free."
nodes.slv3b_154: With a faint warmth touching her ears, Shiori angled her gaze half an inch aside, her voice soft and bright.
nodes.slv3b_155: "...If Yuko-chan overheard you say that tomorrow, she'd be smug about it for weeks. Still... having this stretch of road to walk back unhurriedly makes me glad too."
nodes.slv3b_156: Rounding the final gentle slope of the tree-lined lane together, a mid-rise residential apartment building with a warm glass entrance porch and neatly trimmed greenery came into view ahead.
nodes.slv3b_157: Coming to a stop at the foot of the three stone steps before the entrance porch, Shiori turned around and gestured lightly toward the pale-brick lobby behind her.
nodes.slv3b_158: "Here we are. This is my building."
nodes.slv3b_159: Stopping beside the bottom step as well, Ryuji glanced over the clean, well-lit security glass doors and gave an approving nod.
nodes.slv3b_160: "Quiet neighborhood, well-kept entrance. I'll see you off right here, then."
nodes.slv3b_161: "Mm. Both for coming along to Yuko-chan's dinner tonight and for going out of your way to walk me home... thank you very much, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.slv3b_162: "Don't mention it—I enjoyed both dinner and the walk tonight too."
nodes.slv3b_163: Between the quiet residential buildings, the night breeze settled into stillness.
nodes.slv3b_164: Standing beneath the amber glow of the porch lamp, Shiori slipped her security key fob from her handbag—yet didn't immediately turn to tap the reader.
nodes.slv3b_166: Just about to turn and say goodnight, Ryuji paused and looked back at her.
nodes.slv3b_169: Her fingers tightened ever so slightly around the key fob.
nodes.slv3b_170: Lifting her long lashes, her gaze drifted past Ryuji's shoulder up toward a dark, unlit window on an upper floor of the apartment building; pausing for a breath, her eyes came slowly back down to meet Ryuji's calm, attentive gaze. Warm amber light from the porch reflected deep in her clear eyes, a faint rose warmth brushing the edges of her cheeks; her lips parted half a breath, yet no words came out.
nodes.slv3b_171: Standing quietly where he was, Ryuji neither pressed her to speak nor stepped half an inch closer to crowd her.
nodes.slv3b_172: The hush lasted a brief two or three seconds.
nodes.slv3b_173: Drawing a soft breath, Shiori lowered her lashes to fold the key fob back into her palm; when she looked up again, a gentle, poised smile curved her lips.
nodes.slv3b_174: "Nothing at all. I really had a wonderful time tonight."
nodes.slv3b_175: Stepping half a pace backward onto the first stone step of the porch, hands folded neatly before her, she spoke warmly.
nodes.slv3b_176: "Please get home safely... Goodnight, Dr. Sakaguchi."
nodes.slv3b_177: "Goodnight, Dr. Fujisaki. Get some rest once you're upstairs."
nodes.slv3b_178: Giving a soft nod, Shiori turned and tapped open the ground-floor glass door. Stepping into the warm, brightly lit lobby, she glanced back before the door glided shut and offered Ryuji a small wave from behind the glass—lingering until he nodded and turned away before her slender figure walked unhurriedly toward the elevator.
